thread.topic: HUD message in spectators for all servers

posts.subject: HUD message in spectators for all servers
posts.bodyHtml:
Hello Dream Team,


I had an idea which could be useful for us and for normal players.


I would like to print a message in the HUD when you are looking at a player in spectators like it's already done on the surf ski go 2 server.


[Bild]


I would like to make it for most of the servers and add new information in it.


I would remove the speed and the number of spectators and add other information :



  • Role of the player [ TTT only and for admins only ]
  • Rank points and position [ servers with the rankme plugin and for all players ]
  • Number of bans in sourcebans [ for admins only ]


I'm asking you, Dream Team, if you would allow me to develop that for the servers.


And, of course, if you would like more information in the HUD, you can say it on the thread.

Nice Idea, but on TTT, i would like to have a Hud like,
-Name
-Role
-Killed [Number of players]
-Region where he is coming from (so we can see if he is able to talk german/english)
